title: FrontierPhysics: no configuration passed half of the physical-research tasks

lines: This margin note is in the Diary.

body: According to the note, FrontierPhysics evaluates intelligent agents on 56 end-to-end research tasks created by 42 physicists. Across 22 models and 26 configurations, the best-performing option passed only 46 of 168 rollouts, so no configuration achieved a majority success rate. How were the 56 tasks and 168 rollouts selected and scored? Were the 22 models and 26 configurations evaluated under comparable conditions? What evidence supports interpreting the reported performance as a failure across the evaluated configurations?
